ar: بهاء الدين محمد بن حسين العاملي

description.tr: Safevî polimatı; matematik, mühendislik ve dinî ilimlerde üstün; İsfahan su sistemini tasarladı || Şah Abbas I döneminde İsfahan Şeyhülislamı. || [Tarih notu] İkili rolü Safevî rasyonel ve dinî bilimler entegrasyonunu örnekler.
description.en: Safavid polymath; excelled in mathematics, engineering, and religious sciences; designed Isfahan's water supply || Shaykh al-Islam of Isfahan under Shah Abbas I — highest religious authority who was also a first-rate engineer. || [Historiographical note] His dual role exemplifies the Safavid integration of rational and religious sciences.
description.ar: عالم موسوعي صفوي || شيخ الإسلام في أصفهان
